description: This file implements a PushRegistrationManager actor that handles push notification registrations using either direct or relay transport modes. It encodes registration payloads, interacts with relay servers, manages registration states, and contains related data structures.

classes.name: PushRelayGatewayIdentity
classes.description: A data structure representing a relay gateway's identity, including device ID and public key.

classes.name: PushRegistrationManager
classes.description: An actor managing push registration logic, handling payload creation, relay registration, and state management.

methods.name: makeGatewayRegistrationPayload
methods.description: Creates the registration payload for the specified APNs token, topic, and optional gateway identity, depending on the transport mode.

methods.name: makeRelayPayload
methods.description: Constructs the relay registration payload, communicating with the relay client, and handling cached registration state.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of a string and returns it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: normalizeTokenSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes a token suffix string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an Encodable payload into a JSON string.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether a relay handle has expired based on its expiration timestamp.
